verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's own registered-agent service lists its address on public records, scans incoming documents, uploads them to the customer's cloud account, and sends an alert when official mail arrives. However, the evidence never states a same-day scanning commitment and never confirms the address is a staffed physical street office that accepts in-person service. Missing for 10: a documented same-day scan/upload SLA, explicit confirmation of a physical street office accepting service of process, explicit mention of service of process (not just mail), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, service of process is accepted at a real street office and scanned into my account the same day it is received

citations.quote: Our address is listed as the registered agent on public records instead of yours
Documents scanned and uploaded for digital access from anywhere
we will upload the documents to your secure cloud storage account, email you to let you know there's mail in your account
Get an alert as soon as official mail arrives for you
